user.title: Connect heat pump and sensor
user.description: Select the Zigbee thermometer as the room temperature reference and the heat pump climate entity to control.

data_description.sensor_entity: The sensor used as the room temperature reference.
data_description.heat_pump_entity: The climate entity of the heat pump to control automatically.
data_description.target_temp: Desired room temperature in comfort mode.

error.same_entity: Temperature sensor and heat pump cannot be the same entity.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured.

init.title: Adjust settings
init.description: Change parameters for heat pump control.

data_description.hysteresis: The setpoint only changes when the room temperature deviates more than this from the target. Higher value = fewer changes.
data_description.min_time_between_changes: Minimum wait time between two setpoint adjustments. Prevents rapid switching.
data_description.overshoot: When heating is needed, the heat pump is set to target + this value for more aggressive heating.
data_description.eco_offset: Economy mode uses comfort target minus this value.
data_description.boost_temp: Fixed setpoint for the heat pump in boost mode.
